40020019.author: पदार्थः
40020019.content: तैः by them, वध्यमानाः being tormented, देवाः च gods and, ऋषयः च sages and, तपोधनाः whose wealth is penance, भयार्ताः distressed by fear, शरणम् refuge, जग्मुः went, देवदेवम् to the god of gods, महेश्वरम् to Maheśvara.

40020019.author: Translation
40020019.content: Tormented by them, the gods and the sages whose wealth was penance, distressed by fear, went to Maheśvara, the god of gods, for refuge.

40020020.author: पदार्थः
40020020.content: जगत्सृष्ट्यन्तकर्तारम् the creator and destroyer of the world, अजम् unborn, अव्यक्तरूपिणम् having an unmanifest form, आधारम् the support, सर्वलोकानाम् of all worlds, आराध्यम् adorable, परमम् supreme, गुरुम् teacher.

40020020.author: Translation
40020020.content: They went to him who is the creator and destroyer of the world, unborn, of unmanifest form, the support of all worlds, adorable, and the supreme teacher.

40020021.author: पदार्थः
40020021.content: ते they, समेत्य having approached, तु indeed, कामारिम् the enemy of Kama, त्रिपुरारिम् the enemy of Tripura, त्रिलोचनम् the three-eyed one, ऊचुः spoke, प्राञ्जलयः with folded hands, देवाः the gods, भयगद्गदभाषिणः speaking with voices choked by fear.

40020021.author: Translation
40020021.content: Having approached Shiva, the enemy of Kama, the destroyer of Tripura, and the three-eyed one, the gods, with folded hands and voices choked by fear, spoke to him.

40020022.author: पदार्थः
40020022.content: सुकेशपुत्रैः by the sons of Sukesha, भगवन् O Lord, पितामहवरोद्धतैः uplifted by the boon of Brahma, प्रजाध्यक्ष O Lord of creatures, प्रजाः creatures, सर्वाः all, बाध्यन्ते are tormented, रिपुबाधनैः by their tormenting acts.

40020022.author: Translation
40020022.content: The gods addressed Shiva, saying, "O Lord, O Lord of creatures, all beings are being tormented by the sons of Sukesha, who are uplifted by the boon of Brahma and act as tormentors."

40020023.author: पदार्थः
40020023.content: शरण्यानि places of refuge, अशरण्यानि non-refuge, हि indeed, आश्रमाणि hermitages, कृतानि made, नः by us, स्वर्गात् from heaven, च and, देवान् gods, प्रच्याव्य having dislodged, स्वर्गे in heaven, क्रीडन्ति they play, देववत् like gods.

40020023.author: Translation
40020023.content: They have made our hermitages unsafe, and having driven the gods from heaven, they now play in heaven as if they were gods themselves.

40020024.author: पदार्थः
40020024.content: अहं I am, विष्णुः Vishnu, अहं I am, रुद्रः Rudra, ब्रह्मा Brahma, अहं I am, देवराट् king of gods, अहम् I am, अहं I am, यमः Yama, च and, वरुणः Varuna, चन्द्रः Chandra, अहं I am, रविः Ravi, अपि also, अहम् I am.

40020024.author: Translation
40020024.content: They boast, "I am Vishnu, I am Rudra, I am Brahma, I am Indra, I am Yama, and Varuna, I am Chandra, and I am also Ravi."

40020025.author: पदार्थः
40020025.content: इति thus, माली Mali, सुमाली Sumali, च and, माल्यवान् Malyavan, च and, एव indeed, राक्षसाः demons, बाधन्ते they torment, समरोद्धर्षाः those who delight in battle, ये who, च and, तेषां their, पुरःसराः leaders, तत् therefore, नः to us, देव O god, भयार्तानाम् to those afflicted by fear, अभयं protection, दातुम् to give, अर्हसि you ought.

40020025.author: Translation
40020025.content: Thus, Mali, Sumali, and Malyavan, along with their battle-eager leaders, torment us; therefore, O god, you ought to grant protection to us who are afflicted by fear.

40020026.author: पदार्थः
40020026.content: अशिवं inauspicious, वपुः form, आस्थाय having assumed, जहि kill, वै indeed, देवकण्टकान् thorns of the gods.

40020026.author: Translation
40020026.content: Therefore, assuming a terrible form, indeed destroy these thorns of the gods.

40020027.author: पदार्थः
40020027.content: धन्ते (problematic verb, likely a typo for 'torment' or 'kill'), समरोद्धर्षाः those who delight in battle, ये who, च and, तेषां their, पुरःसराः leaders, इति thus, उक्तः spoken, तु indeed, सुरैः by the gods, सर्वैः all, कपर्दी one with matted hair (Shiva), नीललोहितः blue-red (Shiva), सुकेशं towards Sukesha, प्रति towards, सापेक्षः concerned about, प्राह said, देवगणान् to the hosts of gods, प्रभुः the lord.

40020027.author: Translation
40020027.content: After all the gods had thus spoken about those battle-eager leaders who torment them, Lord Shiva, with matted hair and blue-red form, concerned about Sukesha, spoke to the hosts of gods.

40020028.author: पदार्थः
40020028.content: अहं I, तान् them, न not, हनिष्यामि will kill, मया by me, अवध्याः not to be killed, हि indeed, ते those, सुराः powerful beings, किं तु but, मन्त्रं a counsel, प्रदास्यामि I will give, यः which, वै indeed, तान् them, निहनिष्यति will kill.

40020028.author: Translation
40020028.content: Lord Shiva declared that he would not kill those powerful beings (Rakshasas) because they were invulnerable to him, but he would provide a strategy that would indeed destroy them.

40020029.author: पदार्थः
40020029.content: एतम् this, एव indeed, समुद्योगं plan, पुरस्कृत्य having made primary, महर्षयः O great sages, गच्छध्वं go, शरणं for refuge, विष्णुं to Vishnu, हनिष्यति will kill, सः he, तान् them, प्रभुः the Lord.

40020029.author: Translation
40020029.content: O great sages, taking this very plan as your guide, go seek refuge in Lord Vishnu, for that Lord will surely kill them.

40020030.author: पदार्थः
40020030.content: ततः then, तु indeed, जयशब्देन with cries of victory, प्रतिनन्द्य having acclaimed, महेश्वरम् Lord Shiva, विष्णोः of Vishnu, समीपम् to the vicinity, आजग्मुः they came, निशाचरभयार्दिताः afflicted by fear of night-wanderers.

40020030.author: Translation
40020030.content: Then, indeed, those afflicted by the fear of night-wanderers (Rakshasas) acclaimed Lord Shiva with cries of victory and approached Lord Vishnu.

40020031.author: पदार्थः
40020031.content: शङ्खचक्रधरं bearing the conch and discus, देवं the god, प्रणम्य having bowed down, बहुमान्य having greatly honored, च and, ऊचुः they spoke, सम्भ्रान्तवत् as if bewildered, वाक्यं words, सुकेशतनयान् regarding the sons of Sukesha, प्रति towards.

40020031.author: Translation
40020031.content: Having bowed down and greatly honored the god bearing the conch and discus, they spoke agitatedly concerning the sons of Sukesha.

40020032.author: पदार्थः
40020032.content: सुकेशतनयैः by the sons of Sukesha, देव O Lord, त्रिभिः by the three, त्रेताग्निसन्निभैः resembling the three sacred fires, आक्रम्य having overpowered, वरदानेन by the boon, स्थानानि places, अपहृतानि have been taken away, नः our.

40020032.author: Translation
40020032.content: O Lord, our abodes have been seized and taken away by the three sons of Sukesha, who resemble the three sacred fires, by virtue of a boon.

40020033.author: पदार्थः
40020033.content: लङ्का Lanka, नाम named, पुरी city, दुर्गा impregnable, त्रिकूटशिखरे on the peak of Trikuta, स्थिता situated, । तत्र there, स्थिताः those who reside, प्रबाधन्ते torment, सर्वान् all, नः us, क्षणदाचराः night-wanderers (Rakshasas) ।।

40020033.author: Translation
40020033.content: There is an impregnable city named Lanka, situated on the peak of Trikuta mountain, where night-roaming Rakshasas reside and torment all of us.

40020034.author: पदार्थः
40020034.content: सः that, त्वम् you, अस्मत् our, हितार्थाय for the welfare, जहि destroy, तान् them, मधुसूदन O Madhusudana, । शरणम् refuge, त्वाम् you, वयम् we, प्राप्ताः have attained, गतिः protector, भव be, सुरेश्वर O Lord of gods ।।

40020034.author: Translation
40020034.content: O Madhusudana, for our welfare, you must destroy them; we have sought refuge in you, so be our protector, O Lord of gods.

40020035.author: पदार्थः
40020035.content: चक्रकृत्तास्यकमलान् whose lotus-like faces are severed by your discus, निवेदय offer, यमाय to Yama, वै indeed, । भयेषु in fears, अभयदः giver of fearlessness, अस्माकम् to us, न not, अन्यः another, अस्ति is, भवता by you, विना without ।।

40020035.author: Translation
40020035.content: Offer to Yama those whose lotus-like faces are severed by your discus, for there is no other giver of fearlessness to us in times of fear except you.

40020036.author: पदार्थः
40020036.content: राक्षसान् Rakshasas, समरे in battle, दुष्टान् wicked, सानुबन्धान् along with their followers, मदोद्धतान् arrogant due to pride, । नुदम् dispel, त्वम् you, नः our, भयम् fear, देव O God, नीहारम् mist, इव like, भास्करः the sun ।।

40020036.author: Translation
40020036.content: O God, just as the sun dispels mist, you should dispel our fear by destroying these wicked, arrogant Rakshasas and their followers in battle.

40020037.author: पदार्थः
40020037.content: इति thus, एवम् indeed, दैवतैः by the gods, उक्तः spoken to, देवदेवः the God of gods, जनार्दनः Janardana (Vishnu), । अभयम् fearlessness, भयदः giver of fear, अरीणाम् to enemies, दत्त्वा having given, देवान् to the gods, उवाच spoke, ह indeed ।।

40020037.author: Translation
40020037.content: Thus addressed by the gods, Janardana, the God of gods, who grants fearlessness to his devotees and fear to his enemies, indeed spoke to the gods after granting them protection.

40020038.author: पदार्थः
40020038.content: सुकेशं Sukesha, राक्षसं the demon, जाने I know, ईशानवरदर्पितम् proud due to the boon from Ishana (Shiva), ताम्श्चास्य and his, तनयान् sons, जाने I know, येषां among whom, ज्येष्ठः the eldest, स he, माल्यवान् is Malyavan.

40020038.author: Translation
40020038.content: I know the demon Sukesha, who is arrogant due to a boon from Shiva, and I also know his sons, among whom Malyavan is the eldest.

40020039.author: पदार्थः
40020039.content: तान् those, अहम् I, समतिक्रान्तमर्यादान् who have transgressed limits, राक्षसाधमान् vile demons, निहनिष्यामि will kill, सङ्क्रुद्धः being very angry, सुराः O gods, भवत become, विज्वराः free from fear/anxiety.

40020039.author: Translation
40020039.content: I, being exceedingly angry, will kill those vile demons who have transgressed all limits; therefore, O gods, be free from fear.

40020040.author: पदार्थः
40020040.content: इति thus, उक्ताः spoken to, ते those, सुराः gods, सर्वे all, विष्णुना by Vishnu, प्रभविष्णुना the all-powerful, यथावासम् to their respective abodes, ययुः went, हृष्टाः delighted, प्रशंसन्तः praising, जनार्दनम् Janardana (Vishnu).

40020040.author: Translation
40020040.content: Thus addressed by the all-powerful Vishnu, all the gods, delighted, returned to their respective abodes, praising Janardana.

40020041.author: पदार्थः
40020041.content: विबुधानाम् of the gods, समुद्योगम् the concerted effort/preparation, माल्यवान् Malyavan, तु indeed, निशाचरः the night-wanderer (demon), श्रुत्वा having heard, तौ to those two, भ्रातरौ brothers, वीरौ brave ones, इदम् this, वचनम् word/speech, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40020041.author: Translation
40020041.content: Malyavan, the demon, having heard of the gods' concerted effort, spoke these words to his two brave brothers.

40020042.author: पदार्थः
40020042.content: अमराः the immortals (gods), ऋषयः and the sages, च and, एव indeed, सङ्गम्य having met, किल it is said, शकरम् Shankara (Shiva), अस्मद्वधम् our destruction, परीप्सन्तः desiring, इदम् this, वचनम् word/speech, अब्रुवन् spoke.

40020042.author: Translation
40020042.content: It is said that the gods and sages, having met Shankara, spoke these words, desiring our destruction.

40020043.author: पदार्थः
40020043.content: सुकेशतनयाः sons of Sukesha, देव O god, वरदानबलोद्धताः arrogant due to the strength of boons, बाधन्ते they harass, अस्मान् us, समुद्दृप्ताः exceedingly arrogant, घोररूपाः of terrible form, पदे पदे at every step.

40020043.author: Translation
40020043.content: O god, the sons of Sukesha, who are exceedingly arrogant due to the power of boons and possess terrible forms, harass us at every step.

40020044.author: पदार्थः
40020044.content: राक्षसैः by the Rakshasas, अभिभूताः overcome, स्म we are, न not, शक्ताः able, स्म we are, प्रजापते O Prajapati, स्वेषु in our own, सद्मसु abodes, संस्थातुम् to stay, भयात् due to fear, तेषाम् of those, दुरात्मनाम् wicked ones.

40020044.author: Translation
40020044.content: O Prajapati, we are overcome by these Rakshasas and are unable to remain in our own abodes due to fear of those wicked beings.

40020045.author: पदार्थः
40020045.content: तत् therefore, अस्माकम् our, हितार्थाय for the sake of welfare, जहि destroy, तांश्च and those, त्रिलोचन O three-eyed one, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, हुङ्कृतेनैव merely with a roar, दह burn, प्रदहताम् of those who burn, वर O best.

40020045.author: Translation
40020045.content: Therefore, O three-eyed one, for our welfare, destroy those Rakshasas and burn them merely with a roar, O best among those who can burn.

40020046.author: पदार्थः
40020046.content: इत्येवम् thus, त्रिदशैः by the gods, उक्तः spoken to, निशम्य having heard, अन्धकसूदनः the destroyer of Andhaka, शिरः head, करम् hand, च and, धुन्वानः shaking, इदम् this, वचनम् word, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40020046.author: Translation
40020046.content: Having thus been addressed by the gods and having heard their plea, the destroyer of Andhaka (Shiva), shaking his head and hand, spoke these words.

40020047.author: पदार्थः
40020047.content: अवध्याः not to be killed, मम by me, ते those, देवाः O gods, सुकेशतनयाः sons of Sukesha, रणे in battle, मन्त्रम् counsel, तु but, वः to you, प्रदास्यामि I shall give, यः who, तान् them, वै indeed, निहनिष्यति will kill.

40020047.author: Translation
40020047.content: O gods, those sons of Sukesha are not to be killed by me in battle; however, I shall give you a counsel (or a plan) that will indeed lead to their destruction.

40020048.author: पदार्थः
40020048.content: यः who, असौ that, चक्रगदापाणिः one who holds discus and mace in hand, पीतवासा wearing yellow garments, जनार्दनः Janardana, हरिः Hari, नारायणः Narayana, श्रीमान् glorious, शरणं refuge, तं him, प्रपद्यथ take refuge in

40020048.author: Translation
40020048.content: You should take refuge in that glorious Narayana, also known as Janardana and Hari, who holds the discus and mace in his hands and wears yellow garments.

40020049.author: पदार्थः
40020049.content: हरात् from Hara (Shiva), अवाप्य having obtained, ते they, मन्त्रं the mantra, कामारिम to the enemy of Kama (Shiva), अभिवाद्य having saluted, च and, नारायणालयं to the abode of Narayana, प्राप्य having reached, तस्मै to him, सर्वं everything, न्यवेदयन् submitted

40020049.author: Translation
40020049.content: Having obtained the mantra from Hara and saluted Shiva, they reached the abode of Narayana and submitted everything to him.

40020050.author: पदार्थः
40020050.content: ततः then, नारायणेन by Narayana, उक्ताः addressed, देवाः the gods, इन्द्रपुरोगमाः led by Indra, सुरारीन् the enemies of the gods, तान् them, हनिष्यामि I will kill, सुराः O gods, भवत become, विज्वराः free from anxiety

40020050.author: Translation
40020050.content: Then Narayana addressed the gods, led by Indra, saying, "I will kill those enemies of the gods; O gods, become free from anxiety."

40020051.author: पदार्थः
40020051.content: देवानां of the gods, भयभीतानां who were terrified, हरिणा by Hari, राक्षसर्षभौ O best of Rakshasas, प्रतिज्ञातो promised, वधः destruction, अस्माकं of us, चिन्त्यतां let it be considered, यत् what, इह here, क्षमम् appropriate

40020051.author: Translation
40020051.content: O best of Rakshasas, Hari has promised the destruction of us (Rakshasas) to the terrified gods; therefore, let us consider what is appropriate to do in this situation.

40020052.author: पदार्थः
40020052.content: हिरण्यकशिपोः of Hiranyakashipu, मृत्युः the death, अन्येषां of others, च and, सुरद्विषाम् of the enemies of gods, नमुचिः Namuchi, कालनेमिः Kalanemi, च and, संह्रादः Samhrada, वीरसत्तमः the best of heroes

40020052.author: Translation
40020052.content: The death of Hiranyakashipu and other enemies of the gods, such as Namuchi, Kalanemi, and Samhrada, the best of heroes, was also caused by him.

40020053.author: पदार्थः
40020053.content: राधेयो Radheya, बहुमायी one with many illusions, च and, लोकपालो Lokapala, अथ and, धार्मिकः Dharmika, यमलार्जुनौ Yamala and Arjuna, च and, हार्दिक्यः Hardikya, शुम्भश्चैव Shumbha and, निशुम्भकः Nishumbhaka.

40020053.author: Translation
40020053.content: This verse lists several powerful and deceitful Asuras, including Radheya, Bahumayi, Lokapala, Dharmika, Yamala and Arjuna, Hardikya, Shumbha, and Nishumbhaka.

40020054.author: पदार्थः
40020054.content: असुरा Asuras, दानवाश्चैव and Danavas, सत्त्ववन्तो endowed with strength, महाबलाः very powerful, सर्वे all, समरमासाद्य having entered battle, न not, श्रूयन्ते are heard, अपराजिताः unconquered.

40020054.author: Translation
40020054.content: All these Asuras and Danavas, though endowed with great strength and power, are never heard to have remained undefeated once they entered battle.

40020055.author: पदार्थः
40020055.content: सर्वैः by all, क्रतुशतैरिष्टं hundreds of sacrifices were performed, सर्वे all, मायाविदस्तथा and skilled in illusion, सर्वे all, सर्वास्त्रकुशलाः skilled in all weapons, सर्वे all, शत्रुभयङ्कराः terrifying to enemies.

40020055.author: Translation
40020055.content: All of them had performed hundreds of sacrifices, were skilled in various illusions, proficient in all weapons, and struck terror into their enemies.

40020056.author: पदार्थः
40020056.content: नारायणेन by Narayana, निहताः slain, शतशो by hundreds, अथ and, सहस्रशः by thousands, एतज्ज्ञात्वा having known this, तु indeed, सर्वेषां for all, क्षमं forgiveness, कर्तुमिहार्हथ you should do here.

40020056.author: Translation
40020056.content: Knowing that these very beings were slain by Narayana in hundreds and thousands, you should now grant forgiveness to all of them here.

40020057.author: पदार्थः
40020057.content: ततः then, सुमाली Sumali, माली Mali, च and, श्रुत्वा having heard, माल्यवतो of Malyavan, वचः words, ऊचतुर्भ्रातरं spoke to their brother, ज्येष्ठं elder, भगांशाविव like Bhaga and Amsha, वासवम् to Vasava (Indra).

40020057.author: Translation
40020057.content: Then, Sumali and Mali, having heard the words of Malyavan, spoke to their elder brother, just as Bhaga and Amsha would speak to Indra.

40020058.author: पदार्थः
40020058.content: स्वधीतम् well-studied, दत्तम् given, इष्टम् sacrificed, च and, अपि also, ऐश्वर्यम् sovereignty, परिपालितम् protected, आयुः life, निरामयम् healthy, प्राप्तम् obtained, सुधर्मः good dharma, प्रापितः established, पथि on the path.

40020058.author: Translation
40020058.content: We have diligently studied, given charity, performed sacrifices, maintained our sovereignty, attained a healthy life, and established righteousness on our path.

40020059.author: पदार्थः
40020059.content: देवसागरम् the ocean of gods, अक्षोभ्यम् unagitable, शस्त्रैः with weapons, समवगाह्य having plunged into, च and, जिताः conquered, द्विषः enemies, हि indeed, अप्रतिमाः unequalled, तत् therefore, नः to us, मृत्युकृतम् caused by death, भयम् fear.

40020059.author: Translation
40020059.content: Having plunged into the unagitable ocean of gods with our weapons, and having conquered unequalled enemies, we therefore have no fear caused by death.

40020060.author: पदार्थः
40020060.content: नारायणः Narayana, च and, रुद्रः Rudra, च and, शक्रः Shakra, च and, अपि also, यमः Yama, तथा similarly, अस्माकम् our, प्रमुखे in front, स्थातुम् to stand, सर्वे all, बिभ्यति fear, सर्वदा always.

40020060.author: Translation
40020060.content: Narayana, Rudra, Shakra, and Yama, all of them always fear to stand in our presence.

40020061.author: पदार्थः
40020061.content: विष्णोः of Vishnu, देवस्य of the god, न not, अस्ति is, एव indeed, कारणम् reason, राक्षसेश्वर O lord of Rakshasas, देवानाम् of the gods, एव only, दोषेण by the fault, विष्णोः of Vishnu, प्रचलितम् agitated, मनः mind.

40020061.author: Translation
40020061.content: O lord of Rakshasas, there is indeed no inherent reason for the god Vishnu to act against us; it is only due to the fault of the other gods that Vishnu's mind has been agitated.

40020062.author: पदार्थः
40020062.content: तस्मात् therefore, अद्य today, समुद्युक्ताः fully prepared, सर्वसैन्यसमावृताः surrounded by all armies, देवान् the gods, एव only, जिघांसाम we will kill, एभ्यः from them, दोषः the fault, समुत्थितः has arisen.

40020062.author: Translation
40020062.content: Therefore, today, fully prepared and surrounded by all our armies, we shall kill the gods, for the fault has originated from them.

40020063.author: पदार्थः
40020063.content: एवं thus, सम्मन्त्र्य having deliberated, बलिनः the powerful ones, सर्वे all, सैन्यसमावृताः surrounded by armies, उद्योगं the preparation (for war), घोषयित्वा having announced, तु and, सर्वे all, नैर्ऋतपुङ्गवाः the foremost among the Rākṣasas, युद्धाय for battle, निर्ययुः set out, क्रुद्धा enraged, जम्भवृत्रबला like Jambha, Vṛtra, and Bala (demons), इव as if.

40020063.author: Translation
40020063.content: Having thus deliberated, all the powerful and foremost Rākṣasas, surrounded by their armies, announced their preparations and set out for battle, enraged like the demons Jambha, Vṛtra, and Bala.

40020064.author: पदार्थः
40020064.content: इति thus, ते they, राम O Rama, सम्मन्त्र्य having deliberated, सर्वोद्योगेन with full preparation, राक्षसाः the Rākṣasas, युद्धाय for battle, निर्ययुः set out, सर्वे all, महाकाया of huge bodies, महाबलाः of great strength.

40020064.author: Translation
40020064.content: O Rama, having thus deliberated with full preparation, all those Rākṣasas of huge bodies and great strength set out for battle.

40020065.author: पदार्थः
40020065.content: स्यन्दनैः with chariots, वारणैः with elephants, च and, एव indeed, हयैः with horses, च and, गिरिसन्निभैः resembling mountains, खरैः with donkeys, गोभी with cows, रथोष्ट्रैः with chariots drawn by camels, च and, शिंशुमारैः with porpoises (or crocodiles), भुजङ्गमैः with serpents.

40020065.author: Translation
40020065.content: They set out with chariots, elephants, mountain-like horses, donkeys, cows, camel-drawn chariots, porpoises, and serpents.

40020066.author: पदार्थः
40020066.content: मकरैः with crocodiles, कच्छपैः with tortoises, मीनैर with fish, विहङ्गैः with birds, गरुडोपमैः resembling Garuḍa, सिंहैः with lions, व्याघ्रैः with tigers, वराहैः with boars, च and, सृमरैः with antelopes (or a type of deer), चमरैः with yaks, अपि also.

40020066.author: Translation
40020066.content: They also advanced with crocodiles, tortoises, fish, birds resembling Garuḍa, lions, tigers, boars, antelopes, and yaks.

40020067.author: पदार्थः
40020067.content: त्यक्त्वा having abandoned, लङ्कां Lanka, गताः went, सर्वे all, राक्षसाः the Rākṣasas, बलगर्विताः proud of their strength, प्रयाता set out, देवलोकाय for the world of gods, योद्धुं to fight, दैवतशत्रवः the enemies of the gods.

40020067.author: Translation
40020067.content: All the Rākṣasas, proud of their strength and enemies of the gods, abandoned Lanka and set out for the world of the gods to fight.

40020068.author: पदार्थः
40020068.content: लङ्काविपर्ययम् Lanka's destruction, दृष्ट्वा having seen, यानि which, लङ्कालयानि dwelling in Lanka, अथ and, भूतानि beings, भयदर्शीनि fearful, विमनस्कानि dejected, सर्वशः completely,

40020068.author: Translation
40020068.content: Seeing the impending destruction of Lanka, all the beings dwelling there became utterly fearful and disheartened.

40020069.author: पदार्थः
40020069.content: रथोत्तमैः by excellent chariots, उह्यमानाः being carried, शतशः by hundreds, अथ and, सहस्रशः by thousands,

40020069.author: Translation
40020069.content: Hundreds and thousands of them were being carried by excellent chariots.

40020070.author: पदार्थः
40020070.content: प्रयाताः departed, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, तूर्णं quickly, देवलोकं to the world of gods, प्रयत्नतः with effort, रक्षसाम् of the Rakshasas, एव indeed, मार्गेण by the path, दैवतानि deities, अपचक्रमुः departed,

40020070.author: Translation
40020070.content: The Rakshasas quickly departed to the world of gods with great effort, and even the deities departed by the very path used by the Rakshasas.

40020071.author: पदार्थः
40020071.content: भौमाः earthly, च and, एव indeed, आन्तरिक्षाः atmospheric, च and, कालाज्ञप्ताः commanded by time, भयावहाः terrifying, उत्पाताः portents, राक्षसेन्द्राणाम् for the chief Rakshasas, अभावाय for destruction, समुत्थिताः arose,

40020071.author: Translation
40020071.content: Terrifying earthly and atmospheric portents, commanded by fate, arose for the destruction of the chief Rakshasas.

40020072.author: पदार्थः
40020072.content: अस्थीनि bones, मेघाः clouds, ववृषुः rained, उष्णं hot, शोणितम् blood, एव indeed, च and, वेलां the shore, समुद्राः oceans, च and, उत्क्रान्ताः transgressed, चेलुः trembled, च and, अपि also, अथ then, भूधराः mountains,

40020072.author: Translation
40020072.content: Clouds rained bones and hot blood, oceans overflowed their shores, and mountains also trembled.

40020073.author: पदार्थः
40020073.content: अट्टहासान् loud laughs, विमुञ्चन्तः emitting, घननादसमस्वनाः having sounds like thunder, वाश्यन्त्यश्च and howling, शिवाः jackals, तत्र there, दारुणं terrible, घोरदर्शनाः frightful to behold.

40020073.author: Translation
40020073.content: There, jackals, frightful to behold and making terrible, thunder-like sounds and loud roars, were howling.

40020074.author: पदार्थः
40020074.content: सम्पतन्त्यथ then appearing, भूतानि spirits, दृश्यन्ते are seen, च and, यथाक्रमम् successively, गृध्रचक्रं a flock of vultures, महत् large, च and, अत्र here, ज्वलनोद्गारिभिः emitting flames, मुखैः with mouths.

40020074.author: Translation
40020074.content: Then, ominous spirits were seen appearing successively, and a large flock of vultures with flame-emitting mouths was also present.

40020075.author: पदार्थः
40020075.content: राक्षसानाम् of the Rakshasas, उपरि above, खे in the sky, भ्रमते revolves, अलातचक्रवत् like a firebrand wheel, कपोताः pigeons, रक्तपादाः red-footed, च and, शारिकाः mynah birds, विद्रुताः fled, ययुः went, काकाः crows, वाश्यन्ति caw, तत्रैव right there, बिडालाः cats, वै indeed, द्विपादयः two-footed.

40020075.author: Translation
40020075.content: Above the Rakshasas, the vultures hovered in the sky like a fiery wheel, while red-footed pigeons and mynah birds fled, and two-footed cats and crows cawed right there.

40020076.author: पदार्थः
40020076.content: उत्पातान् omens, तान् those, अनादृत्य disregarding, राक्षसाः the Rakshasas, बलगर्विताः proud of their strength, यान्ति go, एव indeed, न not, निवर्त्तन्ते turn back, मृत्युपाशावपाशिताः bound by the noose of death.

40020076.author: Translation
40020076.content: Disregarding those omens, the Rakshasas, proud of their strength and bound by the noose of death, continued to advance and did not turn back.

40020077.author: पदार्थः
40020077.content: माल्यवान् Malyavan, च and, सुमाली Sumali, च and, माली Mali, च and, सुमहाबलाः exceedingly mighty, आसन् were, पुरःसराः leaders, तेषाम् of them, क्रतूनाम् of sacrifices, इव like, पावकाः fires.

40020077.author: Translation
40020077.content: Malyavan, Sumali, and Mali, all exceedingly mighty, were the leaders of those Rakshasas, just as fires are foremost in sacrifices.

40020078.author: पदार्थः
40020078.content: माल्यवन्तं Malyavan, च and, ते those, सर्वे all, माल्यवन्तम् Malyavan (the mountain), इव like, अचलम् a mountain, निशाचराः night-wanderers (demons), हि indeed, आश्रयन्ति take refuge, धातारम् to Brahma, इव like, देवताः gods.

40020078.author: Translation
40020078.content: All those night-wandering demons indeed took refuge in Malyavan, just as gods resort to Brahma, and as one would take refuge in an unmoving mountain.

40020079.author: पदार्थः
40020079.content: तत् that, बलम् army, राक्षसेन्द्राणाम् of the lords of Rākṣasas, महाभ्रघननादितम् resounding like the crashing of great clouds, जयेप्सया with the desire for victory, देवलोकम् to the world of gods, ययौ went, मालिवशे under the control of Mali, स्थितम् situated.

40020079.author: Translation
40020079.content: That army of the demon lords, resounding like the crashing of great clouds, went to the world of gods, which was under Mali's sway, with a desire for victory.

40020080.author: पदार्थः
40020080.content: राक्षसानाम् of the Rākṣasas, समुद्योगम् preparation, तम् that, तु indeed, नारायणः Nārāyaṇa, प्रभुः the Lord, देवदूतात् from a messenger of the gods, उपश्रुत्य having heard, चक्रे made, युद्धे in battle, तदा then, मनः mind.

40020080.author: Translation
40020080.content: But the Lord Nārāyaṇa, having heard of that preparation by the Rākṣasas from a messenger of the gods, then set his mind on battle.

40020081.author: पदार्थः
40020081.content: सः He, सज्जायुधतूणीरः with weapons and quivers ready, वैनतेयोपरि upon Vainateya (Garuda), स्थितः situated, आसज्ज्य having put on, कवचम् armor, दिव्यम् divine, सहस्रार्कसमद्युति having the brilliance of a thousand suns.

40020081.author: Translation
40020081.content: He, with weapons and quivers ready, stood upon Vainateya (Garuda), having donned his divine armor that shone with the brilliance of a thousand suns.

40020082.author: पदार्थः
40020082.content: आबध्य having fastened, शरसम्पूर्णे full of arrows, इषुधी two quivers, विमले pure, तदा then, श्रोणिसूत्रम् waist-band, च and, खड्गम् sword, च and, विमलम् pure, कमलेक्षणः lotus-eyed (Nārāyaṇa), शङ्खचक्रगदाशार्ङ्गखड्गाख्यप्रवरायुधान् the excellent weapons named conch, discus, mace, bow (Śārṅga), and sword.

40020082.author: Translation
40020082.content: Then, the lotus-eyed Nārāyaṇa fastened his two pure quivers full of arrows, his pure waist-band, and his sword, along with his excellent weapons: the conch, discus, mace, Śārṅga bow, and sword.

40020083.author: पदार्थः
40020083.content: सुपर्णं Suparna (Garuda), गिरिसङ्काशं mountain-like, वैनतेयम् the son of Vinata (Garuda), अथास्थितः then having mounted, राक्षसानाम of the Rakshasas, अभावाय for the destruction, ययौ went, तूर्णतरं very swiftly, प्रभुः the Lord.

40020083.author: Translation
40020083.content: The Lord, having mounted the mountain-like Garuda, the son of Vinata, swiftly departed for the destruction of the Rakshasas.

40020084.author: पदार्थः
40020084.content: सुपर्णपृष्ठे on Garuda's back, सः He, बभौ shone, श्यामः dark-complexioned, पीताम्बरः wearing yellow garments, हरिः Hari (Vishnu), काञ्चनस्य of a golden, गिरेः mountain, शृङ्गे on the peak, सतडित्तोयदो a cloud with lightning, यथा just as.

40020084.author: Translation
40020084.content: Dark-complexioned Hari, adorned in yellow garments, shone on Garuda's back like a lightning-streaked cloud upon the peak of a golden mountain.

40020085.author: पदार्थः
40020085.content: सः He, सिद्धदेवर्षिमहोरगैश्च by Siddhas, Devas, Rishis, and great serpents, गन्धर्वयक्षैः by Gandharvas and Yakshas, उपगीयमानः being praised, समाससाद approached, असुरसैन्यशत्रून् the enemies of the Asura army, चक्रासिशार्ङ्गायुधशङ्खपाणिः holding discus, sword, Sharnga bow, and conch in his hands.

40020085.author: Translation
40020085.content: Praised by Siddhas, Devas, Rishis, great serpents, Gandharvas, and Yakshas, he, holding the discus, sword, Sharnga bow, and conch, approached the enemies of the Asura army.

40020086.author: पदार्थः
40020086.content: सुपर्णपक्षानिलनुन्नपक्षं whose wings (of banners) were scattered by the wind from Garuda's wings, भ्रमत्पताकं with fluttering banners, प्रविकीर्णशस्त्रम् with scattered weapons, चचाल trembled/moved, तत् that, राक्षसराजसैन्यं Rakshasa king's army, चलोपलं with moving rocks, नीलः the blue (mountain), इव like, अचलेन्द्रः the king of mountains.

40020086.author: Translation
40020086.content: That army of the Rakshasa king, with its banners scattered by the wind from Garuda's wings, fluttering flags, and scattered weapons, trembled like a blue mountain king with dislodged rocks.

40020087.author: पदार्थः
40020087.content: ततः then, शरैः with arrows, शोणितमांसरूषितैः smeared with blood and flesh, युगान्तवैश्वानरतुल्यविग्रहैः whose forms were like the fire of cosmic dissolution, निशाचराः the night-wanderers (Rakshasas), सम्परिवार्य having surrounded, माधवं Madhava (Vishnu), वरायुधैः with excellent weapons, निर्बिभिदुः pierced, सहस्रशः by thousands.

40020087.author: Translation
40020087.content: Then, the night-wandering Rakshasas, surrounding Madhava, pierced him by thousands with their excellent weapons, which were smeared with blood and flesh and resembled the destructive fire at the end of an eon. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षष्ठः सर्गः ।। 6 ।। Thus ends the sixth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
